title: تفكيك hotspots المثبتة فقط
objective: Selected hotspots have smaller owned modules and unchanged observable behavior; untouched large files have documented justification.
rationale: Rank by responsibility count, churn, coupling and test coverage; refactor only modules with proven mixed ownership, preserving behavior and public contracts.

preconditions.condition: Pin latest remote head and compare with expected parent before writing.
preconditions.proof: GitHub branch head and commit object.
preconditions.requiredState: Fast-forward continuation with no unresolved concurrent movement.

mustNotStartUntil: Every predecessor is CLOSED_WITH_EVIDENCE on the post-write SHA.

contracts: Canonical OpenAPI and generated clients when affected.
dataObjects: Service-owned schema and ledger objects when affected.
forbiddenPaths: No change to this support package as a substitute for durable owner changes.
outOfScope: Production, release and merge actions without separate authorization.

changeSpecification.targetState: Selected hotspots have smaller owned modules and unchanged observable behavior; untouched large files have documented justification.

exactChanges.symbolOrRange: Task-specific owner, entry, route, component or ledger rows documented in linked evidence.
exactChanges.before: Current state is recorded by linked findings and immutable evidence.
exactChanges.after: Selected hotspots have smaller owned modules and unchanged observable behavior; untouched large files have documented justification.
exactChanges.implementationNotes: Rank by responsibility count, churn, coupling and test coverage; refactor only modules with proven mixed ownership, preserving behavior and public contracts.

forbiddenChanges: No broad bypass, force push, parallel truth source, silent fallback, or deletion without consumer and data proof.
generatedArtifacts: Regenerate only from canonical contract or source owner when affected.
consumerMigrations: Enumerate and migrate direct and indirect consumers before removal or rename.
dataMigrationSteps: Use fresh, upgrade, replay, checksum and preservation paths for persistence changes.
compatibilitySteps: Keep compatibility only for an identified consumer with a dated removal gate.
cleanupSteps: Reference-scan and verify after the last write before removal.
documentationUpdates: Move durable decisions to canonical owners; the package remains disposable.

commands.command: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run guard:dependency-graph
commands.purpose: Smallest sufficient falsification after the last write.
commands.expectedObservableResult: Selected hotspots have smaller owned modules and unchanged observable behavior; untouched large files have documented justification.

positiveCriteria.statement: Selected hotspots have smaller owned modules and unchanged observable behavior; untouched large files have documented justification.
positiveCriteria.evidenceRequired: Command output, diff review and post-write commit SHA.

negativeCriteria: No linked root cause, stale path, bypass, skipped required check or unverified consumer remains.
edgeCriteria: Negative, timeout, concurrent, retry, offline and unknown-result behavior is checked when applicable.
crossSurfaceCriteria: Every affected surface shows the same governed truth and state.
deletionCriteria: Consumer census, replacement, reference scan and rollback proof precede deletion.
mustRemainTrue: DSH owns operational truth; WLT owns financial truth; surfaces use the governed DSH facade for DSH-related finance.

smallestSufficientChecks: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run guard:dependency-graph
claimsNotProvenByTheseChecks: Production behavior unless separately authorized and evidenced.

triggerConditions: Required verification fails after the change.
Data, contract, authorization or runtime behavior regresses.
rollback.codeRollback: Revert only the atomic commit after preserving failure evidence.
rollback.dataRollback: Use service-owned recovery; do not blindly reverse irreversible migrations.
rollback.contractRollback: Restore matching server, generated client and consumer state together.
rollback.operationalRollback: Return affected runtime profiles to the last verified SHA.
